redistribution_note: Per-item correctness only. ChartQA queries, gold labels and chart images are not redistributed by this repository. query_sha256 is a content-free SHA-256 alignment identifier so a holder of the pinned ChartQA test split can verify this evidence indexes the real dataset (see scripts/verify_dataset_alignment.py). It is not anonymization: a corpus holder can map hashes back to queries. The raw prediction string is intentionally omitted, because prediction + correct=true would reconstruct the gold label for every correct item.
